missing: Crime per municipality: no Europe-wide open source; national police statistics differ in method. Nestlyzer shows the EU survey figure per country instead.
Wealth per municipality: not published by any European statistics office in a comparable way.
Income tax per municipality outside Switzerland: published nationally in different forms (for example municipal tax rates in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway, trade-tax rates in Germany). Planned.
Share of foreign citizens per municipality: national censuses publish it, but not in one European table. Nestlyzer shows the regional figure for now.
Flood, landslide and avalanche hazard: official hazard maps are national. Nestlyzer flags places next to a major river, the sea or in mountains so you can check them.
